    Search above, or in a terminal: pip install unlimitedpipe, then unlimited ask "QUESTION", answered from these records with every source cited.

    Get alerts

    unlimited follow WORDS --to ntfy:TOPIC sends each new match to your phone (the free ntfy app, no account), Telegram, Discord or Slack.

    Subscribe

    Every feed is RSS for any reader and JSON for code: the buttons on each card.

    Make your own

    Each feed is a short YAML pipeline; fork one and unlimited publish hosts yours for free on GitHub.

    Where it comes from

    Official APIs, feeds and public pages, read politely (robots.txt, rate limits, an honest User-Agent). Each item links to its source.

    History

    Every item goes into a monthly archive, archive/index.json, so questions about a year or a month reach back. Runs every 1h (live feeds: 30 seconds to 5 minutes).

    Built with UnlimitedPipe, open source: no server, no account, no tracking. Items come from public records and news, each with a link to its source; nothing here is investment, legal or medical advice.
